column1: # - Lines starting with '#' are comments (category headers / provenance).
# - Triggers are lowercase; SmartKey matches case-insensitively and mirrors
#   capitalization onto the expansion (Ko -> Không, KO -> KHÔNG).
# - Expansion fires on Space or punctuation; one Backspace restores the raw trigger.
# - Telex (fcitx5-lotus): keys s f r x j w are tone/mark modifiers ONLY after a
#   vowel inside the same word; 'dd' composes to 'đ'. Flags used below:
#     telex:compose   trigger is usually consumed by lotus before SmartKey sees it
#     telex:safe      contains a modifier key but cannot compose here (no vowel before it)
# - Curated from ViSoLex NSW dictionary (dict/dictionary.json, 3,091 entries),
#   ViLexNorm (EACL 2024, 10,467 pairs) and everyday VN chat usage review.
# - Curation bar: one unambiguous expansion, >90% of real usage; anything
#   polysemous is shielded in slang_vi.txt + audit_ambiguous.tsv instead.
